support_matrix_convention: rows are Pauli-Z character supports; columns are q0,q1,q2,q3

gate_convention.two_body_lowering: RZ_i(theta) RZ_j(theta) CP_ij(-2 theta) = exp(-i theta/2) exp(-i theta Z_i Z_j/2)
gate_convention.lowering_scope: equality is exact up to the displayed global phase

certificate.irrationality_basis: sqrt(2) is irrational; division by nonzero rational 11 preserves irrationality
certificate.certificate_kind: symbolic proposition application, not a floating-point or LCM test

implementation_binding.method: Qiskit double-precision parameters evaluated from math.pi and math.sqrt(2)
implementation_binding.role: circuit execution only; not the irrationality or noncollision certificate
